description: Push a completed conversation turn (user + assistant) into memory for background summarization. Called from an agent's turn hook.

assistant.description: The assistant reply of the turn.

ended_at.description: When the turn finished (stored as its time): epoch seconds or a 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' local timestamp. Optional; default now. For replaying turns that could not be delivered while the daemon was down.

metadata.description: Optional metadata (source, hook, etc.). Accepted and ignored — nothing reads it.

name_source.description: Origin of session_name: 'hermes_title', 'openclaw', 'derived', etc. Omit if no session_name.

session_name.description: Human-readable session/conversation title. Framework-specific: Hermes passes its session title, others may derive from context.

started_at.description: When the user prompt arrived: epoch seconds or a 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' local timestamp. Optional; omit when unknown. Must not be after the turn's own time.

user.description: The user message of the turn.

name: capture_turn
